brief: 5 SaaS pricing models that print money in 2026. Tactical breakdown.

slots.author: GrowthVault
slots.headline: 5 SaaS Pricing Models Dominating 2026
slots.body: Tactical breakdown of the five pricing strategies driving revenue growth for SaaS founders in 2026. Steal the playbook.

slots.author: GrowthVault
slots.title: Usage-Based Revenue Engine
slots.body: Charge for API calls, storage, or compute consumed. Costs scale with customer success, making expansion revenue automatic and predictable.

slots.author: GrowthVault
slots.title: Pay Per Active User
slots.body: Bill only when users log in. Removes buyer risk, accelerates procurement, and converts departments into company-wide deals faster.

slots.author: GrowthVault
slots.title: Good Better Best Tiers
slots.body: Three clear plans anchor value perception. Most buyers pick the middle tier, automatically lifting average revenue per account.

slots.author: GrowthVault
slots.title: Freemium Land And Expand
slots.body: Remove friction with a generous free tier. Convert power users to paid seats once they hit usage limits or need teams.

slots.author: GrowthVault
slots.title: Outcome-Based Hybrid Deals
slots.body: Combine platform fee plus usage overages. Locks in baseline revenue while capturing upside as the client grows and succeeds.

slots.author: GrowthVault
slots.title: Choose Your Pricing Weapon
slots.body: You do not need all five. Audit your value metric, pick the model that aligns with it, and launch by Q2.
